title: TownyLaws
description: TownyLaws is a lightweight TownyAdvanced addon that lets towns and nations create their own law lists.
body:
![Towny-Themed Banner with the Text "TOWNYLAWS".](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e394c863349a501f20cba6dd24c12d6d4e35243e.jpeg)

TownyLaws is a lightweight TownyAdvanced addon that lets towns and nations create their own law lists.

Players can view their town and nation laws directly in chat, while mayors, assistants, kings, and admins can manage laws with simple commands.

No database required. Laws are stored in simple YAML files and can be reloaded without restarting the server.

![Towny-Themed Banner with the Text "FEATURES".](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e920ad88315a97d33d229bb899be64ba19af59b8.jpeg)

• Town laws and nation laws
• View laws with /town laws, /nation laws, or /townylaws
• Mayors and assistants can manage town laws
• Kings and assistants can manage nation laws
• Admin commands for managing any town or nation
• Configurable law limits, page size, and max law length
• Optional law display when joining a town or nation
• Customizable messages
• Simple YAML storage

![Towny-Themed Banner with the Text "COMMANDS".](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/173ef048e038180e3b20dfb544f52f2da6dbeba6.jpeg)

/town laws - View your town's laws
/town laws add <law> - Add a town law
/town laws remove <number> - Remove a town law
/town laws clear - Clear town laws

/nation laws - View your nation's laws
/nation laws add <law> - Add a nation law
/nation laws remove <number> - Remove a nation law
/nation laws clear - Clear nation laws

/townylaws - View your town and nation laws
/townylaws reload - Reload the plugin files
/townylaws town <town> - View or manage another town's laws
/townylaws nation <nation> - View or manage another nation's laws

![Towny-Themed Banner with the Text "PERMISSIONS".](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/94caf1fb61c20a2b807404979b270a00cd028cf4.jpeg)

townylaws.town.manage
Allows town mayors and assistants to manage town laws.
Default: true

townylaws.nation.manage
Allows nation kings and assistants to manage nation laws.
Default: true

townylaws.admin
Allows admins to reload files, manage any town or nation, and bypass normal management checks.
Default: op

![Towny-Themed Banner with the Text "CONFIGURATION".](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d472cecaec5311ca53daf79a31dc474dc301cd3.jpeg)

TownyLaws includes a simple config file where you can change:

• Maximum laws per town
• Maximum laws per nation
• Laws shown per page
• Maximum law length
• Whether laws appear when joining a town or nation
• Color and format code support
• Plugin messages and law display format

![Towny-Themed Banner with the Text "INSTALLATION".](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d42c82afc0620c5e1538bc68a1ac67c23b301ba4.jpeg)

1. Download TownyLaws.
2. Place the jar file in your server's plugins folder.
3. Make sure TownyAdvanced is installed.
4. Restart your server.
5. Edit the config if needed.
6. Run /townylaws reload after making changes.
